segments.ja421:1.3: Atha gāyasi vattāni [vatthāni (ka.)], na taṃ tapati ātapo.
segments.ja421:2.1: Uddhaṃ tapati ādicco, adho tapati vālukā;
segments.ja421:2.3: Atha gāyasi vattāni [vatthāni (ka.)], na taṃ tapati ātapo.
segments.ja421:3.1: Na maṃ tapati ātapo, ātapā [ātappā (sī. syā. pī.)] tapayanti maṃ;
segments.ja421:3.3: Atthā hi vividhā rāja, te tapanti na ātapo.
segments.ja421:4.1: Addasaṃ kāma te mūlaṃ, saṅkappā kāma jāyasi;
segments.ja421:4.3: Na taṃ saṅkappayissāmi, evaṃ kāma na hehisi.
segments.ja421:5.1: Appāpi kāmā na alaṃ, bahūhipi na tappati;
segments.ja421:5.3: Ahahā bālalapanā, parivajjetha [paṭivijjhetha (pī. sī. aṭṭha.)] jaggato.
segments.ja421:6.1: Appassa kammassa phalaṃ mamedaṃ, udayo ajjhāgamā mahattapattaṃ;
segments.ja421:6.3: Suladdhalābho vata māṇavassa, yo pabbajī kāmarāgaṃ pahāya.
segments.ja421:8.1: Sandiṭṭhikameva “amma” passatha, khantīsoraccassa ayaṃ [yo (syā. pī. ka.)] vipāko;
segments.ja421:8.3: Yo [so (syā. ka.)] sabbajanassa vanditohu, taṃ vandāma sarājikā samaccā.
segments.ja421:9.1: Mā kiñci avacuttha gaṅgamālaṃ, muninaṃ monapathesu sikkhamānaṃ;
segments.ja421:9.3: Eso hi atari aṇṇavaṃ, yaṃ taritvā caranti vītasokāti.
